messages.subject: auxiliary.free_only added to config.template.yaml, key verified against pinned version
messages.body: Phase one confirmed auxiliary.free_only is real in Hermes v0.21.0 (image tag v2026.8.31): the raw source at agent/auxiliary_client.py on that exact tag's docstring reads 'auxiliary.free_only: true restricts the step-2 fallback to :free SKUs; auxiliary.openrouter_model overrides the default. A one-time WARNING is logged for non-:free models' -- matching the deploy-log warning almost verbatim; I also found GitHub issue #24029 (v0.13.0) proposing this exact flag as a fix, showing it was added after that version and is present by v0.21.0. I added the auxiliary: free_only: true block to hermes/config.template.yaml with a comment tying it to the /usr/bin/bash.01171/run benchmark, left _config_version at 39 (nothing in this repo reads that field and no evidence tied its bump to an additive key), re-ran hermes/render_config.py and confirmed the rendered config.yaml parses clean with auxiliary.free_only present, and both uv run pytest (149 passed, 5 deselected) and uv run mypy . (no issues, 38 files) are green. Nothing left on this task: no commit, push, or Railway change was made, pending your approval to commit hermes/config.template.yaml.
